reviewScope: Internal engineering/model-consistency and browser viewport review,not independent expert,official-board,manufacturer,physical-device or calibration certification. Chosen pure-water reference,approximately atmospheric pressure,constant representative heat capacities/latent heat and ideal net sample thermal control. No electrical efficiency,apparatus heat capacity,supercooling,nucleation delay,evaporation,boiling or spatial gradients. Reference enthalpy defined relative to0°C ice. Representative cube is not crystal growth or a dynamic floating-body solver. Static support/flotation preserves liquid inventory;192-facet circular rendering approximates an analytic cylinder with less than0.02percent cross-sectional facet error. Shared ice/liquid contact drawn once to avoid duplicate coplanar surfaces;controller/glass base separated. Heat-flow arrows are illustrative,not material transport. No measured FPS,physical printing or pointer-orbit certification.
